title: PPG Change and Impact
description: Version-bound review change summaries. Draft capture does not approve or issue policy.

fields.name: ChangeKey
fields.schemaXml: <Field Type="Text" Name="ChangeKey" StaticName="ChangeKey" DisplayName="ChangeKey" Required="TRUE" Indexed="TRUE" EnforceUniqueValues="TRUE"></Field>

fields.name: ReviewTriggers
fields.schemaXml: <Field Type="MultiChoice" Name="ReviewTriggers" StaticName="ReviewTriggers" DisplayName="ReviewTriggers" Required="TRUE"><CHOICES><CHOICE>Scheduled review</CHOICE><CHOICE>Legislation or directive</CHOICE><CHOICE>Standards change</CHOICE><CHOICE>Audit recommendation</CHOICE><CHOICE>Incident recommendation</CHOICE><CHOICE>Evidence update</CHOICE><CHOICE>Technology or service change</CHOICE><CHOICE>Feedback</CHOICE><CHOICE>Ad hoc improvement</CHOICE></CHOICES></Field>

fields.name: MajorChanges
fields.schemaXml: <Field Type="Note" Name="MajorChanges" StaticName="MajorChanges" DisplayName="MajorChanges" Required="FALSE" RichText="FALSE" NumLines="6"></Field>

fields.name: MinorChanges
fields.schemaXml: <Field Type="Note" Name="MinorChanges" StaticName="MinorChanges" DisplayName="MinorChanges" Required="FALSE" RichText="FALSE" NumLines="6"></Field>

fields.name: Rationale
fields.schemaXml: <Field Type="Note" Name="Rationale" StaticName="Rationale" DisplayName="Rationale" Required="TRUE" RichText="FALSE" NumLines="6"></Field>

fields.name: Interactions
fields.schemaXml: <Field Type="Note" Name="Interactions" StaticName="Interactions" DisplayName="Interactions" Required="FALSE" RichText="FALSE" NumLines="6"></Field>

fields.name: ImplementationActions
fields.schemaXml: <Field Type="Note" Name="ImplementationActions" StaticName="ImplementationActions" DisplayName="ImplementationActions" Required="FALSE" RichText="FALSE" NumLines="6"></Field>

fields.name: UnresolvedQuestions
fields.schemaXml: <Field Type="Note" Name="UnresolvedQuestions" StaticName="UnresolvedQuestions" DisplayName="UnresolvedQuestions" Required="TRUE" RichText="FALSE" NumLines="6"></Field>

fields.name: DecisionEvidence
fields.schemaXml: <Field Type="Note" Name="DecisionEvidence" StaticName="DecisionEvidence" DisplayName="DecisionEvidence" Required="FALSE" RichText="FALSE" NumLines="6"></Field>

fields.name: GuideBinding
fields.schemaXml: <Field Type="Note" Name="GuideBinding" StaticName="GuideBinding" DisplayName="GuideBinding" Required="FALSE" RichText="FALSE" NumLines="6"></Field>

identity: Unique ChangeKey per document/from/proposed edition and change-record revision; preserve key when editing; native item versions retain corrections.
directFormLimitations: Native forms enforce required fields/choices/unique key. Cross-record version/authority and decision-evidence checks remain manual; RecordState is not clinical approval.
